scope: Proposition 4.4 (Dyadic uniqueness) of the manuscript “Ambiently homeomorphic isolated hypersurfaces of multiplicities two and three” (preprints/Ambiently-homeomorphic-isolated-hypersurfaces-of-multiplicities-two-and-three-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 059 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ce7e450c32aa20ca), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let L be a finite free Z2-module, and let T satisfy Tm = 1 for an odd m. Suppose 1 is not an eigenvalue of T on L ⊗ Q2. Any two T-invariant unimodular symmetric forms on L are equivariantly isometric over Z2.
